title: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs: Off-by-one in hop limit forward check
description: Line 606: `if rreq.hop_limit > 1` should be `if rreq.hop_limit > 0`. With the current check, packets with hop_limit=1 are NOT forwarded even though the destination may be exactly 1 hop away. Example: hop_limit=4 allows only 3 forwards (reaching hop 4), not 4 forwards (reaching hop 5). A node at hop_limit=1 that is not the destination will return HopLimitExhausted instead of forwarding with hop_limit=0, which would allow the next node to be the destination.
close_reason: Fixed off-by-one: changed 'hop_limit > 1' to 'hop_limit > 0' at line 623 in loadng.rs. hop_limit=1 now correctly forwards with hop_limit=0, allowing destination to be exactly 1 hop away. Updated test to use hop_limit=0 for exhaustion case, added new test for hop_limit=1 forwarding.
